about_the_game:
Paradise has fallen. You were born to restore it. The Shape encourages you.

Explore the secrets of a lush planet with ancient ruins as a celestial spirit called Kuzo. With a growing array of world-altering powers, you’ll traverse deeper regions and uncover the haunting story of the Drowned Planet in your quest to restore a bridge to the metaphysical world, and ultimately save the planet from catastrophe.

After awakening from his thousand-year gestation, Kuzo discovers the Shape, an ancient technology that carries world-altering magic: Spawn rising lily pads on the surface of any body of water. Transform spiky hazards into usable platforms. Control moving lifts and gates that mimic the Shape’s movement along an axis. Spawn crawling horizontal vines to quickly traverse low ceilings. There are many secrets within the Shape.

Kuzo combines the thrill of the beloved 2D platformer with the freedom to make creative decisions while navigating the world.

Features

  • Platform through an interconnected world. Expand your abilities and use them creatively to progress. There are endless ways to get where you’re going.

  • Explore over a dozen hand-crafted environments, from the center of a fallen civilization to dark, uncharted caves deep underground, and beyond.

  • Solve labyrinthine, puzzle-box dungeons, each with  unique mechanics and effects its surroundings, and each housing a critical ability.

  • Discover secrets hidden in plain sight as you gain knowledge of the world and its systems.

  • Meet and help otherworldly NPCs, diverse beings trapped in remote corners of the abandoned planet.

  • Immerse yourself in an original soundtrack that evolves with your journey.

  • Collect and equip items to customize your journey to your preferred play style.

  • Unravel a story of epic proportions that unfolds through environmental storytelling. What exactly happened to this once-thriving land?

The Shape invites you to discover the secret history of the Drowned Planet. Will you fulfill your purpose and connect with the ancient civilization that created you, or will Paradise remain forever submerged? The fate of this world rests in your hands.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 (with updated drivers) or AMD Radeon R7 240
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible

short_description: Blaze a unique trail as you platform through an interconnected, hand-drawn world full of ancient secrets and hidden magic. Test your wits in puzzle-box dungeons, uncover hidden paths to unlock your powers, and wield the mysterious Shape to create the very platforms you'll ascend to your destiny.
